nixpkgs.expr: let findFlake = dir: if builtins.pathExists (dir + "/flake.nix") then dir else if builtins.pathExists (dir + "/nix/flake.nix") then dir + "/nix" else if toString dir == "/" then throw "No flake.nix found" else findFlake (dir + "/.."); flake = builtins.getFlake ("path:" + toString (findFlake ./.)); in import flake.inputs.nixpkgs { }

nixos.expr: let findFlake = dir: if builtins.pathExists (dir + "/flake.nix") then dir else if builtins.pathExists (dir + "/nix/flake.nix") then dir + "/nix" else if toString dir == "/" then throw "No flake.nix found" else findFlake (dir + "/.."); flake = builtins.getFlake ("path:" + toString (findFlake ./.)); in flake.nixosConfigurations.nixos.options

hjem.expr: let findFlake = dir: if builtins.pathExists (dir + "/flake.nix") then dir else if builtins.pathExists (dir + "/nix/flake.nix") then dir + "/nix" else if toString dir == "/" then throw "No flake.nix found" else findFlake (dir + "/.."); flake = builtins.getFlake ("path:" + toString (findFlake ./.)); in flake.nixosConfigurations.nixos.options.hjem.users.type.getSubOptions [ ]
